fusions.name: Tangle Snare
fusions.desc: Lashes a tangle of matted hair at one enemy up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Shed Bristles
fusions.desc: Your swarm flicks 6 shed bristles in a wide spray, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Woven Burrow Mouth
fusions.desc: Weaves a wall of matted hair and nesting rats 5 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Thickening Nest
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (56% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
